content: GNU screen multiuser mode: multiuser on + acladd/aclchg/acldel/aclgrp/aclumask; permission bits r/w/x where w=may type into window, x=may run screen command, per-window and per-command granularity (aclchg user +rwx 1,2,7,select); attaching user defaults to full permissions once known; groups inherit owner permissions; WRITELOCK: only one user can type in a window at once - auto mode grants lock to first typer, released on window leave (writelock on keeps it) - screens answer to multi-writer chaos is single-writer lock; per-user password optional; requires setuid binary for cross-user.
